From aspiration to execution ⚖️
​With sincere gratitude to my mentors, family, and peers, I am proud to announce that I have officially received my Sanad and joined the roll of Advocates with the Bar Council of Maharashtra & Goa.
​Earning the Sanad is not a finish line—it is the formal start of a lifelong commitment to justice, client advocacy, and continuous learning.
​Excited for the road ahead and the responsibilities that come with the gown.
